card.title: PS5 USB firmware update error diagnosis

source.title: PS5 USB Data Lines to APU Routing and Firmware Error Diagnostics

claims.statement: USB data lines go direct to the APU
claims.evidence: Blue arrow tracing lines from USB ports to the APU chip

claims.statement: APU is faulty and not fixable if error message is 'Multiple USB drives are connected'
claims.evidence: Text annotation next to the error message list

card.caveats: Does not provide specific voltage or resistance measurements for troubleshooting.
